The '''Gravan system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] which contained [[Gravan Seven]].

==History==
In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]] officer [[Gara Petothel]] [[Slicer/Legends|sliced]] the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] database to indicate that the system was secured when it actually still contained ex-[[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces under [[Zsinj]]'s command.
